methodology: Gross research reference returns, equal weighted across the original published names. Entry is the first completed session close after publication; exit is the last completed session of the stated period. Split-adjusted closes plus cash distributions; distributions reduce short returns. Excludes commissions, slippage, financing and borrow costs. These are fixed-cohort reference calculations, separate from live account performance.
